We develop UNICASE for the Eclipse platform with the Eclipse Java IDE.

We currently use the following development tools:

    * [http://java.sun.com/javase/downloads/index_jdk5.jsp Java 5 SE]
    * [http://phoenix.eclipse.org/packages/ Eclipse 3.4: Modeling Tools Edition] (Ganymede)
          o EMF <br>
          o GEF, GMF <br>
          o Ecore Tools <br>

    * Eclipse Plugins
          o UNICASE: install via Update Manager - http://wwwbruegge.in.tum.de/static/unicase. <br>
          o COPE: install via Update Manager - http://cope.in.tum.de/update-site/site.xml.<br>
          o Subclipse: install via Update Manager - http://subclipse.tigris.org/update_1.4.x.<br>
          o Checkstyle: install via Update Manager (use version 4.x) - http://eclipse-cs.sourceforge.net/update.<br>
          o Findbugs: install via Update Manager - http://findbugs.cs.umd.edu/eclipse.<br>


Getting started as developer in 7 easy steps:

1. Download and install [http://java.sun.com/javase/downloads/index_jdk5.jsp Java].

2. Download [http://phoenix.eclipse.org/packages/ Eclipse] and install the required plugins (see above).

3. Checkout the UNICASE source code from the [http://code.google.com/p/unicase/wiki/SVN_Repository svn repository] (see this link: http://code.google.com/p/unicase/source/checkout).

4. Configure Java and Checkstyle warnings as described in [http://code.google.com/p/unicase/wiki/Coding_Guidelines Coding Guidelines].

5. Start the UNICASE server from Eclipse, see this [http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/StartEmfStore.mov video tutorial].

6. Start the UNICASE client from Eclipse, see this [http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/StartUnicaseClient.mov video tutorial].

7. Register for our [http://code.google.com/p/unicase/wiki/Mailinglist mailinglists].


If you have any questions please consider the FAQ and Developer FAQ and do not hesitate to use our mailinglist.

Note: We use UNICASE to model unicase, also called boot strapping or eat-your-own-dogfood.See here: http://code.google.com/p/unicase/wiki/Unicase_repository_beta_server   for details.
